value.rationale: The exact rank and spectral fibers of finite-field rank-one commutators are natural matrix invariants motivated by a new rank-one commutator study. One uniform formula treats all finite-field sizes and matrix dimensions and reveals a genuine nilpotent index-three boundary and characteristic-two semisimplicity transition. This provides an interpretable full classification rather than a single small computer enumeration.
